g.text: An asynchronous photobooth for long-distance friends to make a new photo together.
Quiet product chrome. Expressive outputs. Warm paper, confident black, faded color, handmade accents.
Georgia for emotional moments · Inter for everything functional
No scheduling. No group call. Just one
shared booth, completed in your own time.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT · EXPIRES IN 90 DAYS
Make it feel like your group—not a template.
Start from a complete look. Change details later.
Only people with this private link—after all
Tap when you're ready · 5 second timer
YOUR PHOTO ISN'T UPLOADED UNTIL YOU CONFIRM
Nothing is shared until you confirm.
The photos stay hidden until everyone is in.
You can close this page. Come back with the same link.
Tap a photo to crop, zoom, rotate or swap
Add a caption or handwritten note…
Choose what appears on the final artifact.
PHOTOS STAY PRIVATE · NO PUBLIC FEED
Upload → wait → push notification → live photo reveal
The creator and participants can leave after confirming. The PWA brings them back only when the shared artifact is ready.
Your photo is uploaded and hidden.
You can leave—we'll hold your place.
ONE NOTIFICATION · NO STREAKS OR REMINDER SPAM
Install Timecapsule, then allow a single
notification when this booth is complete.
Required for iPhone and iPad push
Requested only after you tap below
PERMISSION IS OPTIONAL AND CAN BE REVOKED ANYTIME
Four time zones, still us is complete.
Tap to watch the photostrip print.
TAP OPENS THE PRIVATE REVEAL URL
The strip prints downward from the slot
Shadow deepens as more paper appears
Settle: subtle 8 px overshoot, no bounce loop
Show the complete strip with a 180 ms fade.
Choose a themed pack → tap a sticker → insert at canvas center.
44 PX MINIMUM HANDLES · SNAP GUIDES · UNDO/REDO
Add title, names, date, caption, or handwritten note.
DOUBLE TAP TO EDIT · DRAG ANYWHERE ON SELECTION
Classic strip · horizontal · double strip · grid · editorial collage · freeform.
WARN ONLY WHEN AN ITEM WILL BE CROPPED
REPLIT HANDOFF · PWA + WEB PUSH · PRIVATE BOOTH SUBSCRIPTIONS · MOTION.DEV OR CSS KEYFRAMES · PRESERVE REDUCED MOTION · NO NOTIFICATION SPAM
